Everything the regular sniper does? This demon does better. A small handful of such shooters are within Barghest’s ranks, and they shouldn’t be challenged without a literal tank or a half-dozen cannon fodder to drain their ammo. Otherwise, hide. If you can.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Barghest).

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.

The Nekomata requires care, regular service and time to learn how best to use it. But it's really, really worth it. This electromag sniper rifle is a technological marvel. The tungsten spike it launches can pierce the thickest armor and walls, and shatter titanium bones. No one is safe from the Nekomata's destructive force, which is why the sale of this rifle is strictly regulated. It's almost impossible for mercs outside the employ of a government or major megacorp to get their hands on one... almost.

Cost: 5,000eb (Luxury)

Class: EQ Sniper Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Sniper Rifle

Damage: 6d6 • Capacity: 4 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Sniper Rifle Rechamber, Tech Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: This weapon’s Tech Rebuild is capable of seeing simple target outlines through one layer of Thin or Thick Cover. While Charged, this weapon can fire through up to one layer of Thin Cover or Thick Cover and, whenever it would ablate armor, ablates 1 additional SP.

Range: Sniper Rifle
Pre-installed: Sniper Rifle Rechamber, Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

A rare ballistic mask with a titanium-plated visor and an absurdly sized optical suite. Mostly used by assassins, spies, and other psycho-killers even capable of affording it.

SP11 Head Armor with no Armor Penalty. Has built-in Anti-Smog Breathing Mask, Smart Ears, and Smart Glasses. The Smart Glasses have pre-installed Targeting Scope and TeleOptics, which do not consume any Option Slots and cannot be removed. Its visor may be raised or lowered as an Action. While the visor is lowered, this helmet is considered to have a built-in Zetatech Tank Commander Headset, its user gains access to cybereye options installed in the Smart Glasses, and Human Perception Checks against the user suffer a -4 penalty.

Covers: Head
